svg.title: For clarity, source deviation has the following meaning. Two sources have identical regular and forced address layouts. There are nonnegative envelopes cα, dα such that on each regular healthy domain every left derivative through order k of their difference is bounded by cα, and on every configuration every forced coefficient difference is bounded by dα. Both total weighted sums X α ee covB(Xα)cα, X α ee covB(Yα)dα
